sections.title: Safe and Centralized Control
sections.body: The Kenya AI Compute Portal is your central hub for managing all aspects of your relationship with our project. We utilize multi-factor authentication (MFA) and encrypted session management to ensure that your sensitive financial and technical data remains protected. Once logged in, investors can access their quarterly distribution reports, construction timelines, and Data Room documents. Compute customers can manage their GPU/CPU instances, monitor real-time energy usage (PUE), and handle their billing and support tickets. For our DePIN partners, the portal provides a dashboard to track node performance and token earnings. We are committed to radical transparency, and this portal is the primary tool we use to deliver that promise to every member of our ecosystem. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
